About Alessandra Sagredo

What a curious thing it is to be human.

Pain. Pleasure. And the delicious absurdity of it all.

If life were a lover, I'd describe our relationship in one word. Tumultuous. I'm fascinated by the emotional ups and downs of being human, the sensual nature of our existence and our obsession, while we're still living, with what comes next.

Why do I do what I do? I'm compelled to. I love all things mystic. I love to inspire others.

What delights me is watching their wonder as they discover something about themselves or the beauty that surrounds them. To experience their joy alongside them, or perhaps a moment of peace or relief.

I create in everything I do. I like to bring more beauty and life to each moment. Writing, teaching, exploring consciousness, helping someone preserve a memory or talking about death are all expressions of that curiosity.

Perhaps something here will inspire you. Perhaps it will bring you a little relief or joy. That would delight me.
